title: The Master Appears
next_chapter_hook: The entrance to the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds emanated an eerie chill. Mo Xiansheng's words made Chen Ji's heart race—the name Chen Tianming, that legendary name, was so tightly bound to his fate.

text.content: The voice fell like frost and snow, carrying an inexplicable coldness. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, but he didn't turn around—with the Tianqing Sect, no more than three people could approach silently at such a distance. He slowly exhaled a breath of stale air, his voice unusually calm: 'Since the Master says there's a script, your disciple would like to ask—who is the playwright of this play?' A soft laugh came from behind, carrying not a trace of warmth: 'Playwright? Hmph, do you think this is a grand performance anyone can take the stage for?'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng strolled to Chen Ji's side, his residual soul phantom appearing especially ethereal under the moonlight. His gaze fell upon the fragment in Chen Ji's hand, the corners of his lips curving into a meaningful arc: 'Impressive, impressive indeed. Three years of intricate planning, manipulating the three major sects at will—this temperament bears a striking resemblance to Chen Xuan's in his prime.' He paused, then shifted his tone: 'Unfortunately, what you perceive as a 'chess game' is merely a corner of someone else's chessboard.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart stirred slightly, though his expression remained impassive. He turned his head, for the first time truly looking at this nominal 'Master'—Mo Xiansheng's aura was unfathomable, the edges of his residual soul phantom tinged with a faint ink-colored glow, an aura unique to the Tianji Record. For three years, he had never seen Mo Xiansheng appear in his true form, and this sudden appearance was by no means coincidental. Chen Ji said calmly: 'The Master appears today, surely not just to teach your disciple a lesson?'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze deep as an abyss: 'I came to give you a choice.' He waved his hand, and a blurry image materialized in the void—a girl bound in chains, her features bearing a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji. 'Chen Nian, the person you've been searching for for three years, is in my hands. Hand over the eighth page of the Tianji Record, and I'll set her free.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, the knuckles gripping the fragment instantly turning white. She was the one person he had never dared to use the Tianji Record to glimpse over these three years—because his sister's life was his逆鳞.

text.content: Silence froze in the air for several breaths. Chen Ji's expression gradually settled from shock into calm, a calm that bordered on terrifying. He spoke slowly, his voice carrying not a trace of波动: 'Since the Master knows she is my sister, you must also understand—any foresight image containing her is always blurred.' He lifted his eyes, his gaze sharp as a blade: 'So the Master should understand—using her to threaten me is the stupidest choice.'

dialogue.content: Instead of anger, Mo Xiansheng burst into laughter: 'Good! Good indeed for a 'stupidest choice'!' His laughter echoed through the night sky, carrying both gratification and mockery, 'Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, you're just like your father—arrogance carved into your bones. Unfortunately, you think I'm threatening you?' He stepped forward, almost pressing within three feet of Chen Ji, 'I'm giving you a chance. Do you know what the eighth page of the Tianji Record is? It's the key to open the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds. And the person you seek, the truth you investigate, all lie deep within the forbidden grounds.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat, letting that oppressive aura wash over him. In his mind, calculations raced—Mo Xiansheng's words contained half-truths, half-falsehoods, but one thing was certain: he indeed knew Chen Nian's whereabouts, even the secrets of the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds. Chen Ji said coldly: 'Since the Master holds the secret of the forbidden grounds entrance, why not retrieve it yourself? Why use this 'useless disciple'?' Mo Xiansheng's smile deepened: 'Because only you can open the eighth page of the Tianji Record. Do you think I waited three years for no reason?'

Chen Ji's heart sank. Mo Xiansheng's words confirmed his darkest suspicions—this 'Master' had been targeting him from the very beginning. Three years of protection, occasional guidance, even those seemingly casual hints—all were pushing him toward some predetermined轨道. He spoke slowly, his voice gaining a chill: 'So your disciple must ask the Master one question—are you enemy or ally?' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then turned and walked toward the imperial city: 'Enemy or ally? Save such childish questions for when you see the truth within the forbidden grounds.'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted back: 'Follow me. The entrance to the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds opens once every seven days, and tonight is the seventh.' He paused, his tone carrying a hint of amusement, 'As for the name Chen Tianming—you shouldn't be unfamiliar with it, right? The things your father left behind are far more than just the Tianji Record fragment.' Chen Ji's steps faltered. Chen Tianming—that name appeared occasionally in the letters left by his father, also the mystery he had always tried to investigate. How much did Mo Xiansheng really know?

text.content: Chen Ji did not follow immediately. His gaze fell upon Mo Xiansheng's residual soul phantom as he suddenly spoke: 'The Master says only I can open the eighth page of the Tianji Record, then what is the Master?' Mo Xiansheng's footsteps stopped, but he did not turn around: 'I am the chess player, not a chess piece. Are you satisfied with this answer?' The corner of Chen Ji's lips slightly rose, that smile carrying not a trace of warmth: 'A chess player? Then your disciple would like to know—besides your disciple, what other chess pieces are on the Master's chessboard?'

Mo Xiansheng finally looked back, moonlight casting dappled shadows across his phantom. His gaze was profound and complex, like looking at a fruit about to ripen: 'This question is somewhat premature.' He drew a symbol in the void, and a blurry rune appeared: 'But since you asked, I shall tell you—the struggles of the three major sects, the demonic path's invasion, even the布局 of Heaven's Eye, all lie within my chessboard.' His voice was low as an ancient bell: 'And you, Chen Ji, are the chess piece I value most.'

Chen Ji did not speak. He only quietly looked at Mo Xiansheng, dark currents surging in his eyes. After three years of playing the weak to devour the strong, he had long grown accustomed to hiding his edge before any powerful figure. But at this moment, facing this self-proclaimed chess player, an unprecedented battle intent rose in his heart. He spoke unhurriedly: 'Since the Master says I am a chess piece, your disciple would like to try—' He took a step forward, 'Can this chess piece bite back at the chess player?'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed a massive amount of information, and now Chen Ji must make a decision—whether to follow this mysterious master to the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, or first probe his true intentions?

choices.description: Since both his sister and the truth lie within the forbidden grounds, there is no reason not to go. Even if this is a trap, he must step into it personally.
choices.visible_cost: Lose control over the eighth page of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues to the forbidden grounds entrance and his sister's whereabouts
choices.risk_hint: Entering an unknown forbidden grounds, may face greater dangers

text.content: Chen Ji收起 the Tianji Record fragment, his expression calmly following Mo Xiansheng's footsteps. He knew from this moment on, he had officially stepped into a larger chess game. And what he needed to do was find his own position within this game of chess.

choices.description: The information revealed by Mo Xiansheng is too shocking, must first confirm his true stance. Blindly following will only land himself in a passive position.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the timing of the forbidden grounds opening
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about Chen Tianming

text.content: Chen Ji did not move, his gaze fixed on Mo Xiansheng's back: 'The Chen Tianming you mentioned, Master—what is his relationship with my father? What secret does this forbidden land hold that you cannot tell your disciple in advance?' Mo Xiansheng stopped, his voice carrying a hint of praise: 'A good question. But some answers are not mine to give.'

choices.text: Take the initiative to test strength
choices.description: Since the other party calls himself a chess player, let's first gauge this 'Master's' worth.
choices.risk_hint: If Mo Xiansheng's strength far exceeds imagination, he may fall into danger

text.content: A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes as the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly radiated dazzling brilliance. He didn't activate his foresight, but instead released a wisp of sword intent sealed within the fragment, aiming directly at Mo Xiansheng's back. Mo Xiansheng remained motionless, yet the sword intent dissolved three inches from him, as if striking an invisible wall. 'A decent probe,' he said indifferently. 'But this alone isn't enough to make me take you seriously.'

Mo Xiansheng's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, as if reassessing him. After a brief pause, he murmured: 'You are more cautious and ruthless than Chen Xuan. That is both good and bad.' He turned and continued forward, his voice drifting back: 'Follow me. After tonight, you will understand many things.' Chen Ji hesitated no longer, his figure flashing as he followed. The two figures raced toward the imperial city, one after another. The night wind stirred Chen Ji's robes, his eyes deep as an abyss—regardless of whether Mo Xiansheng was friend or foe, he had already embarked on this path. And he never regretted his choices.

The entrance to the imperial forbidden land lay beneath an abandoned watchtower in the northwestern corner of the imperial city. When Chen Ji arrived with Mo Xiansheng, a faint black mist permeated the area around the watchtower, its气息 identical to Mo Xiansheng's own. Mo Xiansheng raised his hand and traced a rune in the air. The rune resonated with the mist, and a dark crack slowly appeared. 'After entering, you will see things you shouldn't see,' Mo Xiansheng's voice was low. 'Remember, no matter what you see, do not waver.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared at the dark crack and suddenly spoke: 'Master, I have one final question for you.' Mo Xiansheng paused, turning his head slightly. Chen Ji's gaze met his eyes directly, his voice calm yet carrying an undeniable force: 'Is the person you want me to meet Chen Tianming?' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then suddenly smiled—that smile held praise, amusement, and an indescribable anticipation: 'Go in and see for yourself, won't you?' With that, he stepped into the crack first, his remnant soul shadow swallowed by darkness.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his sleeve. He knew that once he stepped through this crack, he would be completely exposed within Mo Xiansheng's chess game. But this was also the closest he had been to the truth in three years. He did not hesitate. His figure flashed as he followed Mo Xiansheng into the crack. Darkness surged like a tide, an icy aura enveloping his entire body. In the final instant before consciousness was swallowed, he heard Mo Xiansheng's voice, like a sigh from ancient times: 'Welcome to the true chess game, Chen Ji. From now on, you will witness the true face of the Tianji Record.'

choice.prompt: After entering the forbidden land, Chen Ji found himself in a strange space—around him flowed a sea of black clouds, and beneath his feet stretched a stone bridge with no visible end. At the bridge's end, a faint light glimmered. Mo Xiansheng said that was where the person he was to meet resided.

choices.description: Since he's already here, there's no need to hesitate. The truth is right before his eyes—he must confirm it as soon as possible.
choices.visible_reward: See the target figure at the earliest opportunity
choices.risk_hint: There may be dangers within the forbidden land

text.content: Chen Ji quickened his pace, the stone bridge echoing沉闷ly beneath his feet. Just as he was about to reach the light, the surrounding black clouds suddenly churned violently. A massive hand emerged from the clouds, reaching directly for Chen Ji's back. Chen Ji's figure recoiled, and the Tianji Record Fragment blazed brilliantly, forcing back the attacking hand. Mo Xiansheng's voice came from behind: 'Be careful—the things here do not welcome uninvited guests.'

choices.description: The forbidden land is fraught with dangers—rushing ahead blindly will only put oneself in a passive position. Must first understand the layout here.
choices.visible_reward: Discover hidden runes on the stone bridge

text.content: Chen Ji slowed his pace, his gaze scanning the surroundings. He noticed the stone bridge was covered with dense, intricate runes, those runes resonating with the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand. He crouched down, his fingertip touching one of the runes. A familiar force surged into his body through his fingertip. The Tianji Record Fragment quivered slightly, as if resonating with these runes. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: 'You've discovered them. These runes are marks left by the Tianji Record holders throughout the ages.'

choices.description: Since Mo Xiansheng calls himself the Chess Player, he should know this place like the back of his hand. Why not let him lead the way to reduce the risks?
choices.visible_reward: Gather More Information About Mo Xiansheng

text.content: Chen Ji stopped and turned to look at Mo Xiansheng: 'Since Master is so familiar with this place, perhaps you could give your disciple some guidance?' Mo Xiansheng smiled, pointing toward the end of the stone bridge: 'Follow the runes, don't deviate. You will see the person you wish to meet.' His voice carried a deeper meaning: 'Remember, no matter what you see, don't cry out. That would only make you seem worthless.'

Chen Ji followed the rune guidance, the light at the end of the stone bridge growing ever closer. When he stepped onto the final stone step, the scene before him made his pupils constrict—a chamber constructed of ink-colored crystals, with a illusory figure suspended in its center. The figure's features were blurred, yet it emanated a terrifying pressure. What shocked Chen Ji even more was that standing beside the figure was someone he had been searching for three years—Chen Nian. Her eyes were closed, as if in slumber, or perhaps imprisoned.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice resounded from behind, carrying an indefinable emotion: 'Chen Ji, the person you've been searching for three years is here.' He stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji, 'And the truth you wish to know—' He made a gesture, and the illusory figure gradually clarified, revealing a face seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's. Chen Ji's entire body froze, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand trembling violently. Mo Xiansheng's voice was low as an ancient bell: 'This is Chen Tianming, your father, and the previous wielder of the Tianji Record. And your sister is the key to unlocking the Tianji Record's final seal.'

text.content: Chen Ji stared fixedly at that familiar yet unfamiliar face, the psychological defense he had carefully constructed over three years cracking at this moment. His father—that figure long blurred in his memory, now appeared before him in this manner. He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm: 'So what Master means is—my father is not dead?' Mo Xiansheng shook his head: 'He is dead, but his will remains.' He gazed at the illusory figure, 'This is the remnant consciousness he left behind, waiting for someone destined to inherit his legacy. And you, Chen Ji, are the only qualified person.'

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming's Remnant Consciousness has appeared, and sister Chen Nian is imprisoned beside him. Mo Xiansheng has revealed a shocking secret, and now Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this situation.

choices.description: Regardless of the truth, sister's safety is the top priority. She has been imprisoned for three years and can wait no longer.
choices.risk_hint: May Anger Chen Tianming's Remnant Consciousness

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flashed, darting directly toward where Chen Nian was. However, the moment he drew near, an invisible force repelled him. Chen Tianming's remnant consciousness slowly spoke, his voice aged and majestic: 'No rush, Nian-er is temporarily safe.' Chen Ji steadied himself, his gaze coldly fixed on the illusory shadow: 'You certainly have composure. For three years, your son searched the entire world, while you 'slumbered' in a place like this?'

choices.description: Since father's remnant consciousness has appeared, all the questions accumulated over three years should be clarified. Why did he leave? Why did he leave the Tianji Record Fragment with him?
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian Cannot Be Rescued for Now
choices.risk_hint: May Need to Make a Major Promise

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the agitation in his heart, his gaze fixed directly on Chen Tianming's remnant consciousness: 'Father, three years ago you left without a word, leaving only a fragmented Tianji Record. Tell me—why was this?' Chen Tianming's remnant consciousness fell silent for a moment before finally speaking: 'Because the complete version of the Tianji Record needs to be inherited by you.' He made a gesture, and the Tianji Record Fragment flew from Chen Ji's sleeve, resonating with the remnant consciousness, 'And to inherit the complete Tianji Record, you must make a choice.'

choices.description: This game is too large, and Mo Xiansheng's true motives remain unclear. Without first clarifying his stance, one must not act hastily.
choices.visible_reward: Seeing through Mo Xiansheng's hidden hand

text.content: Chen Ji did not look at Chen Tianming's remnant will, but turned to Mo Xiansheng instead: "Master, what is your true purpose in bringing me here?" Mo Xiansheng met his gaze, the corner of his mouth slightly curving up: "You think I've been using you?" He shook his head. "No, I'm giving you a chance. The complete version of the Tianji Record is enough for you to contend against the Eye of Heavenly Dao. But the price is—you must accept Chen Tianming's legacy and become the new chess master."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed through the secret chamber, carrying a hint of seduction: "Mastering the Tianji Record means possessing the ability to foresee heavenly secrets and manipulate the world. Your father achieved this, and you—" he looked at Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in his eyes, "you possess a crueler disposition and deeper scheming than he did. As long as you're willing, you can become the true chess player of this chaotic era." Chen Ji fell silent. Chess player—this was exactly the realm he had yearned to reach for three years. But now, facing this choice, he felt an unprecedented chill.

text.content: Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Master, you've omitted one thing." He raised his head, his gaze like a blade. "The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of destiny. How did you forget to mention this?" Mo Xiansheng's expression stiffened momentarily, then returned to normal. "You truly know everything." Chen Ji coldly laughed: "I've been playing the pig to devour the tiger for three years, not to become a real pig. I will bear the price of the chess player—but I need to know the full cost."

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming's remnant will suddenly spoke, his voice ancient and weary: "Ji'er, you're right." He slowly raised his illusory palm, pointing to Chen Nian beside him. "Her existence is precisely to bear this backlash for you." Chen Ji shuddered all over, staring intently at the phantom: "What did you say?" Chen Tianming's remnant will revealed a bitter smile: "When I passed the Tianji Record to you, I knew you would walk this path. So I made Nian'er the Heavenly Fate Key, locking away a portion of the backlash power within you. As long as she exists, you will not die."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill spread from the soles of his feet throughout his entire body. He looked at the sleeping Chen Nian—that person he had searched for three years, now connected to him in such a way. He suddenly understood something, his voice trembling: "So when you left back then, was it to protect her? Or to protect me?" Chen Tianming's remnant will fell silent for a moment: "Both. But more importantly—" his gaze deepened, "I had to let you grow alone, tempering your disposition in adversity. Only then could you truly master the power of the Tianji Record."

Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. Three years of restraint, three years of scheming, three years of searching—it turned out that from the very beginning, he had been within his father's chess game. He slowly opened his eyes, his anger and unwillingness gradually replaced by an even deeper emotion. He looked at Mo Xiansheng, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "What a touching father-son drama. But Master—" his voice abruptly turned cold, "since you know everything, let me ask you one question. Why did you betray my father back then?" Mo Xiansheng's expression finally changed.

dialogue.content: The atmosphere in the secret chamber suddenly froze. Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while before finally letting out a long sigh: "You truly can't be deceived about anything." He turned around, his back facing Chen Ji. "I did not betray your father. I was executing his final orders." Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly: "What do you mean?" Mo Xiansheng's voice was low: "Back then, Chen Tianming knew his time was running out. He split me off, letting me guard the Tianji Record in a remnant soul form until you grew strong enough. And now—" he turned around, his gaze directly fixed on Chen Ji, "it's time for you to know the entire truth."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng waved his hand, and an illusory scene unfolded in the secret chamber. It was thirty years ago—young Chen Tianming stood atop a towering peak, behind him were countless strong ones he had outmaneuvered. Beside him stood a young man with features similar to Chen Ji, the young Mo Xiansheng. "Back then, we all thought we were chess players." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of regret. "Until the Eye of Heavenly Dao appeared, we realized—we were merely pieces on an even larger chessboard."

Chen Ji watched the illusory scene, his heart churning with indescribable emotions. He suddenly understood many things—his father's restraint, Mo Xiansheng's protection, even his own three years of scheming were all merely struggles to break the shackles of destiny. He took a deep breath, his gaze gradually becoming resolute: "So you brought me here tonight to let me inherit my father's will and oppose the Eye of Heavenly Dao?" Mo Xiansheng nodded: "But before that, you need to make a choice—whether to accept this legacy and become a true chess player, or—"

Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly stopped. He looked toward the entrance of the secret chamber, his brow slightly furrowing: "Someone is coming." Chen Ji's heart tightened. Anyone who could enter the forbidden grounds of the imperial city was no ordinary person. Mo Xiansheng's voice became urgent: "There's no time left, Chen Ji. Your choice—" he made a gesture, and the Tianji Record Fragment and Chen Tianming's remnant will both erupted with dazzling light, "must be made now!"

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng urged Chen Ji to make an immediate choice, while strange movements came from the entrance of the forbidden grounds, as if strong experts were approaching. The situation was extremely critical.

choices.description: Since there's no turning back, accept the father's legacy and formally become a chess player.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Complete Power of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji stretched out his hand and grasped the suspended light. In that instant, a torrential stream of information flooded into his mind—the memories, wisdom, and power of generations of Tianji Record masters. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, the text upon it beginning to reorganize and evolve, gradually presenting entirely new content. Chen Ji felt his perception rapidly expanding, as if the entire heavens and earth were under his control.

choices.text: Demand to Rescue Chen Nian First
choices.description: The legacy can wait, but the sister must be taken first. She absolutely cannot fall into others' hands.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Timing of Legacy
choices.risk_hint: May Anger Chen Tianming's Remnant Spirit

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flashed, dashing directly toward Chen Nian. This time, he encountered no obstruction—Chen Tianming's remnant will proactively dispersed the barrier. Chen Nian's body drifted toward Chen Ji, caught steadily by him. She remained in deep sleep, her expression peaceful, as if these three years of imprisonment were merely a dream. Chen Ji held her tightly, his voice low: "Father, the legacy can wait, but she cannot remain here."

choices.text: Refusing to accept the inheritance and leave
choices.description: This chess game is too large; he needs more time to think. Accepting rashly would only leave him even more passive.
choices.visible_cost: Possibly losing the power left behind by his father
choices.risk_hint: Possibly angering Mo Xiansheng and the residual will of Chen Tianming

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, shielding Chen Nian behind him: "This inheritance is too heavy; I need time to consider." Mo Xiansheng's expression suddenly turned gloomy: "Chen Ji, you have no time." Chen Ji coldly smiled: "You're right, it's too late. So—" He turned to look toward the entrance of the secret chamber, "Let's talk somewhere else." With that, his figure flashed, actually rushing directly toward the approaching figure.

Yet just as he was about to burst out of the secret chamber, a familiar aura rushed toward him. Chen Ji's footsteps halted, his pupils constricting sharply—it was someone he never expected to appear here. Su Qingyao's figure emerged from the darkness, her body surrounded by a faint azure glow, her expression as cold as frost. Seeing Chen Ji, she was slightly stunned, then a complex light flickered across her eyes: "Chen Ji? As expected, it's you." Her voice carried neither surprise nor relief, "I knew you were here."

Chen Ji gazed at this woman who had been infinitely close to the truth three times, his heart filled with myriad emotions. He knew that from this moment, the废物 persona he had meticulously constructed over three years would completely crumble. He shook his head with a bitter smile, his voice carrying a hint of helplessness: "Senior Su, you truly are relentless." Su Qingyao ignored his teasing, her gaze falling on Chen Nian in his arms, her brow furrowing slightly: "Is this... your younger sister?" Chen Ji offered no response, only holding her even more tightly.

Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, then spoke: "I've been tracking you for three years, investigating your true identity." Her voice remained calm, yet carried an imperceptible weariness. "Now I finally understand—you're no废物 disciple at all, but the most dangerous person in the entire Tianqing Sect." Chen Ji looked at her and suddenly smiled: "Since Senior Su knows all this, why not directly expose me?" Su Qingyao's gaze met his, a fleeting, indecipherable emotion flickering in the depths of her eyes: "Because beyond your danger, what I truly want to know is—what are you truly scheming?"

Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then spoke: "Senior Su, would you be willing to listen to a very long story?" Su Qingyao said nothing, simply watching him quietly. Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from behind, carrying a playful tone: "Interesting. The chess pieces of fate are finally gathering." Chen Ji didn't turn around, merely softly stating: "Master, this story—will likely have to wait until the next chapter." His gaze pierced through the secret chamber, looking toward the deeper parts of the forbidden imperial city grounds—where his father's final riddles lay hidden, and where his ultimate destiny awaited.
